annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes FastBNB as a way to deposit or stake BNB for stated daily returns, including a 3% figure, and provides instructions to purchase BNB, transfer it to MetaMask, and deposit it into the platform. It also associates referral activity with additional percentage-based earnings and discloses that linked products may generate a commission for the speaker, although the video includes a disclaimer that earnings are not guaranteed.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: FastBNB participation is presented as staking or yield farming in exchange for stated passive daily returns. The source explicitly links staking BNB to earning 3% daily, describes an Ox plan with 3% daily for 90 days, and instructs viewers to purchase and deposit BNB into FastBNB. The source describes income connected to referring users through multiple levels and earning from a downline, supporting a tiered recruitment-commission mechanism.
